initial_reconstruction.claim: Canonical field matching and whole-answer/primary endpoints are separate constructs. EAL has 31 canonical matches but 30 whole-verdict matches and 30 primary successes; Facts has 20 of each and Conventional has 33 of each. Equality of some totals does not make the endpoints conceptually interchangeable.
